item.summary: The First National SARAS Mela held outside Delhi-NCR - organised as an initiative of the Ministry of Rural Development, Government of India, in collaboration with the Government of Andhra Pradesh - concluded recently at Punnami Ghat, Vijayawada, Andhra Pradesh. It brought together around 1,500 women entrepreneurs from Self-Help Groups (SHGs) and Lakhpati Didis from 30+ States and Union…
item.title: First National SARAS Mela 2026 (outside Delhi NCR) Concludes on a High Note in Vijayawada, Records Over ₹12.8 Crore in Sales and Attracts More Than 12 Lakh Visitors
